notes: Fixed: your Pro license can no longer be lost if the license server has a hiccup, and it now survives updates
Fixed: the App Uninstaller now removes only the selected app's own files, never other apps from the same vendor
Trash: put back anything MacDiskCleaner moved, free for everyone (returns the size to your free allowance)
The app is now simply named MacDiskCleaner and is signed for a stable identity
Corrected system requirement: macOS 14 Sonoma or later
New Developer tab: safely clears Xcode data, node_modules, build folders and package caches, with project-aware safety labels
New Space Lens: explore what is using your disk folder by folder and remove it
Free plan: scan everything and clean up to 2 GB — Pro removes the limit
Choose exactly what to scan, with live progress and time remaining
Scan results are saved, so there is no rescan after a restart or after activating Pro
Buy Pro from inside the app and it unlocks automatically
Optional menu bar item with free space and quick actions
Never-touch list: folders MacDiskCleaner will not scan results from or delete
Built-in update checker with one-click install
First public release: duplicate finder, large & old file finder, downloads cleanup and junk cleaner
Universal app for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs
Pro tools: App Uninstaller, Privacy Cleaner, Startup Manager, Scheduled Scans
